kups_spec = load_kups_md_experiment("02", "smoke")
kups_result = run_kups_md_experiment(
    kups_spec,
    raw_run_dir=Path("runs/notebook-post-02/smoke"),
    quiet=True,
)
for case in kups_result.cases:
    print(
        f"{case.name}: frames={case.frame_count}, atoms={case.atom_count}, "
        f"max |dE/E0|={case.max_abs_relative_energy_error:.3e}, "
        f"device={case.observed_devices[0]}, hdf5={case.hdf5_sha256[:12]}"
    )
